IDENTIFY THE RACE CONDITION IN THE PROVIDED PYTHON CODE THAT INCREMENTS THE GLOBAL VARIABLE counter VIA THE FUNCTION increment ACROSS 4 threading.Thread INSTANCES EACH CALLING increment(100000).

PROVIDE A VERSION THAT USES A threading.Lock TO SYNCHRONIZE THE increment OPERATION.

INCLUDE TEST CODE FOR EACH FIX THAT RUNS THE THREADS AND PRINTS THE FINAL counter VALUE, CONFIRMING IT MATCHES THE EXPECTED 400000.
